findings.evidence: l.835-841 and the `bundleSections_coboundary_iff` body each pass `(τ i) (q i)` as the target frame and then use `simp only [Trivialization.scalarCoordChange_self …, one_mul]`.
findings.fix: Add a lemma `bergmanSection_coordinate_self`: `q (τ.continuousLinearMapAt ℂ x (τ.bergmanSection … u x)) = representative u (e x)`. Rewrite the own-frame terms with it, or with `simp [bergmanSection_coordinate, bergmanSection_coordinate_self]`, instead of passing every argument by hand.
findings.issue: `bundleSections_coboundary_iff` and `mem_cocycles₁_iff_toBundleSections₁_apply` (l.821) read a section in its own frame in a roundabout way: they call `bergmanSection_coordinate` with `τ i` against itself, then simp `scalarCoordChange_self` to 1. This happens five times, each in a long `rw` chain with every coverage proof written out, which breaks easily.

findings.evidence: The grep for `ext|ext_iff` in LineBundle/Basic.lean finds only `theorem ext` at l.184. The `congrArg (fun s ↦ holomorphicSectionSheaf.toFun …)` pattern appears at l.933 and l.1027.
findings.fix: Add `holomorphicSectionSheaf.ext_iff` (only `ext` exists, l.184 of LineBundle/Basic.lean). Rewrite with it and run one `simp`, instead of the duplicated `constructor` blocks.
findings.issue: The same back-and-forth between a section equation and a pointwise equation is written four times. Both directions appear in `mem_cocycles₁_iff_toBundleSections₁` and in `mem_compatibleTriples_iff_toBundleSections` (l.1027): `holomorphicSectionSheaf.ext` with a `simpa only [add_apply, sub_apply, map_apply, …]` one way, and `congrArg (fun s ↦ toFun … s ⟨x, hx⟩)` with the same simp set the other way.

findings.evidence: l.596 and l.620 both contain `isFiniteMeasure_restrict.2 ((measure_mono subset_closure).trans_lt (e.isCompact_closure_imageOpens hK (hKU.trans hU)).measure_lt_top).ne`.
findings.fix: Factor the instance term out as a named lemma or `private instance`-style lemma (`isFiniteMeasure_restrict_imageOpens hK hKU hU`) and use it in both places.
findings.issue: The `IsFiniteMeasure (volume.restrict …)` instance term is copied verbatim from `holomorphicSectionToBergman` (l.596) into `holomorphicSectionToBergman_apply`. The theorem then only elaborates because the local instance happens to match the one inside the def.

findings.evidence: `oOneRealization` is defined `by letI … ; exact (…).bergmanSection …`, and the theorem rebuilds the instance with `let : MemTrivializationAtlas … := ⟨⟨i, rfl⟩⟩`.
findings.fix: Unfold explicitly (`rw [oOneRealization]` or `unfold oOneRealization`), or state an `oOneRealization_eq` lemma. Add a comment explaining why the instance is rebuilt.
findings.issue: `oOneRealization_injective` closes with `exact Trivialization.bergmanSection_injective _ _ _ _ _ _`. This only works because Lean silently unfolds the tactic-built `oOneRealization` def and because a re-declared `let` `MemTrivializationAtlas` instance matches the one inside it. Neither dependence is documented.

summary: The proofs work, but several repeat the same reasoning in long rewrite chains with spelled-out arguments when small lemmas would do. Two examples also depend on unfolding definitions without saying so.
